jobs.title: Senior Mine Engineer/Planner - PL#27347
jobs.description:
Peter Lucas Project Management invests in people, community, and to provide gold standard project delivery. We are currently looking for an experienced Senior Mine Engineer / Planner to join our team.

At Peter Lucas, we provide project management, engineering, procurement, and construction management services to clients in the mining, energy, and heavy industrial sectors. We are seeking a versatile mining professional with strong technical capabilities, operational experience, and the ability to mentor and support the development of junior engineers.

About the Opportunity

The Senior Mine Engineer / Planner will provide senior-level technical support to an active mining operation on a 2 weeks in / 2 weeks out rotation. This position includes camp accommodations, flights, and travel support to and from site.

This role is ideal for an experienced mining engineer who enjoys working across multiple disciplines, solving complex technical challenges, and supporting the growth of junior team members through coaching and knowledge sharing.

What You'll Do

  • Provide senior-level mine engineering support to mining operations and project teams.
  • Develop and maintain short-term and long-term mine plans, schedules, and production strategies.
  • Support underground mine planning activities including stope layouts, sequencing, development planning, and optimization.
  • Review and optimize mining methods, designs, and operational approaches.
  • Provide technical support related to ventilation planning, air requirements, and mine ventilation improvements.
  • Collaborate with geology, operations, maintenance, and technical services teams to improve mine performance.
  • Prepare engineering designs, reports, technical studies, and recommendations.
  • Support mine design reviews, feasibility studies, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Analyze production data and identify opportunities to improve safety, productivity, and operational efficiency.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior mining engineers and technical staff.
  • Support the implementation of engineering standards, procedures, and best practices.
  • Participate in site visits, field inspections, and operational reviews as required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Compensation ranges from $120,000 to $160,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.

jobs.requirementsSection:
• Bachelor’s degree in Mining Engineering or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of progressive mine engineering experience.
  • Strong underground mining experience with exposure to mine planning, stope design, and production optimization.
  • Experience with ventilation systems and mine infrastructure planning considered an asset.
  • Strong understanding of underground mining methods, sequencing, and operational requirements.
  • Experience with mine planning software such as Deswik, Vulcan, Datamine, or similar platforms.
  • Strong technical writing, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proven ability to mentor, coach, and develop junior engineers.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills.
  • Professional Engineering designation (P.Eng.) or eligibility considered an asset.
  • Mining operations experience is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Automotive Refinish Technician
jobs.description:
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Automotive Refinish Technician with a strong commitment to quality workmanship and precision. The ideal candidate will be proficient in all stages of the refinishing process, from surface preparation and colour matching to paint application and final finishing, consistently delivering results that meet our high standards of quality.

Key Responsibilities

Paint Preparation & Primer Application

  • Prepare repaired and replacement panels for primer application, including sanding, feather-edging, cleaning, masking, seam sealing, and surface preparation.
  • Evaluate repaired surfaces to identify imperfections requiring correction before primer application.
  • Apply primers and sealers in accordance with manufacturer specifications.
  • Block sand and refine primed surfaces to achieve proper contour, smoothness, and finish quality.
  • Ensure all surfaces are properly prepared to prevent refinishing defects.

Final Preparation for Paint

  • Independently prepare complete vehicle repairs for paint application.
  • Perform final sanding, scuffing, masking, cleaning, and degreasing of all applicable panels.
  • Identify and correct surface imperfections before vehicles enter the spray booth.
  • Ensure proper preparation of blend panels, replacement panels, and repaired surfaces.
  • Maintain high standards for cleanliness and contamination prevention.

Paint Mixing, Colour Matching & Application

  • Demonstrate proficiency with the BASF Glasurit 100 Line waterborne paint system.
  • Accurately retrieve, mix, and adjust paint formulas to achieve precise OEM colour matches.
  • Produce and evaluate spray-out cards to verify colour accuracy before application.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of colour theory, metallic orientation, pearl finishes, and blending techniques.
  • Apply basecoat, clearcoat, and other refinishing products in accordance with BASF technical procedures.
  • Perform panel blending and multi-panel refinishing to achieve consistent colour and finish quality.

Paint Finishing & Quality Control

  • Perform denibbing, wet sanding, polishing, and final paint correction.
  • Identify and correct minor paint defects, including dust inclusions, texture inconsistencies, and surface imperfections.
  • Inspect completed refinishing work for colour accuracy, gloss, texture, and overall finish quality.
  • Ensure completed repairs meet OEM standards and internal quality-control expectations.

jobs.title: Summer Student - Environment
jobs.description:
Job Title: Summer Student – Environment
Date Posted: October 26, 2026

Closing Date: November 16, 2026
Job Type: Student
Display Category: Internal/External Opportunities

Location: Calgary

 

Powering a bright future starts with you! 

At AltaLink, people are at the heart of our success. We are a team committed to doing the right thing for each other and our customers. We foster an environment that is inclusive, collaborative and high performing and we value personal accountability. Our people are empowered to continuously improve, deliver outstanding customer service and make a meaningful impact every day. We embrace the unique identities, experiences and perspectives of our workforce, reflecting the communities where we operate. Everyone at AltaLink can expect to work in a safe, respectful environment where trust and commitment are at the core of how we operate.  

Oh, and, what do we do? 

We power Alberta! Our transmission lines deliver electricity to millions of Albertans 24 hours a day, seven days a week. When you’re on our team, you’re supporting Alberta’s homes, farms, businesses and industries by providing the safe, reliable and affordable electricity they rely on. Whether working in the field or in the office, every AltaLinker contributes to keeping the lights on. Want to join our team? We’re excited to share that we are hiring a Summer Student to join our Environment team.

NOTE: The start date is May 2027, and the length of the term is 4 months. 

Job Description:

A summer student position is available in the AltaLink Environment Team and report to the Manager of Environment. Working with Environmental Advisors, the successful candidate will assist with the collection, analysis, and organization of environmental and regulatory information required to advance reclamation certificate applications and support environmental compliance initiatives.

Additionally, the summer student may provide general support to the Environmental Team in daily field and office activities which may include conducting compliance inspections, wildlife surveys and support in construction implementation.   

Responsibilities:

  • Assist with the compilation and review of historical environmental, land, and construction records associated with salvaged and abandoned transmission line assets.
  • Support the preparation of reclamation certificate applications, including document management, data compilation, and quality assurance reviews.
  • Conduct field work throughout Alberta to complete Detailed Site Assessments (DSAs), collect site information, document vegetation, soil, and landscape conditions, and support reclamation evaluations.
  • Assist environmental staff with field audits and inspections of construction and maintenance activities to verify compliance with environmental commitments, permits, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support data management, mapping, reporting, photo documentation, and preparation of project deliverables for regulatory submissions and internal tracking.
  • Compile, organize and analyze data to support the Environmental Management Program.
  • Work with our Environmental Advisors to research, develop and collaborate on technical documents and training materials.
  • Participate in environmental inspections for facilities and projects.
  • Provide support to the EH&S Team as required.
  • Assist in co-ordination of an AltaLink employee environmental event.
  • All candidates must demonstrate key behaviors and meet identified expectations outlined in our four cultural pillars – one team, continuous improvement, customer focus and personal accountability.

jobs.requirementsSection:
• Enrolled in a diploma or degree program for Environmental Sciences, Environmental Engineering, Biology, Forestry or Land Reclamation or a related field.
  • Completed a minimum of 1 year of study and will be returning to school.
  • Knowledge of provincial and federal environmental legislation.
  • Proven ability/experience in the above noted responsibilities.
  • Proficiency in ESRI ArcGIS Pro is an asset.
  • Proficient in standard MS Office/M365 programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and SharePoint and would be a strong asset.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including solid writing and editing skills and the ability to translate highly technical topics into easily understood language.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and carry projects through to completion within a changing environment.
  • Work effectively independently and in a team setting.
  • Proven track record of good attendance
  • Valid driver’s license.

 

Notes:

Candidates chosen asked to provide their unofficial transcripts.

Internal employees must submit their resume internally at https://referrals.workable.com/altalink/jobs/ By doing so, it helps ensure that your application receives appropriate internal consideration.

External candidates must submit their application via Workable externally at AltaLink - Current Openings (workable.com).

AltaLink employees should be aware that we may contact your manager during the selection process.  Some positions may require job specific assessments, regular criminal record checks, additional AltaLink training, medical assessments, annual drivers abstract, and drug tests.  Please contact the Hiring Manager or Recruiter for further clarification if required.

We thank all candidates for their interest in a career with AltaLink. Due to the high volume of applications, we will only be contacting candidates being considered for an interview. We sincerely appreciate all interest and invite all candidates to follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook and/or X.

In proceeding with your application, you will be required to submit personal information to AltaLink through our applicant tracking service provider and this information will be accessible to AltaLink personnel involved in AltaLink’s hiring processes.  AltaLink also relies on third parties to assist in the hiring process and your information may be provided to them for this purpose. In the application process, AltaLink will require you to provide consent to the collection, use, and storage of your personal information for these purposes.

At AltaLink, we celebrate diversity and inclusion. We are committed to fair employment practices, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, religious beliefs, colour, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical disability, mental disability, age, ancestry, place of origin, marital status, family status, source of income, sexual orientation or any other category protected by applicable provincial or federal law.

jobs.requirementsSection:
We are looking for a talented Design Artist to join our team on a stylized CG animated TV featurette during the color keys stage. The project's visual style and art direction have already been established, and the artist will help bring this vision to life through color key development and background painting. The ideal candidate can work confidently within an existing style, creating cohesive artwork that supports the project's storytelling, mood, and visual consistency. 

Responsibilities 

  • Create color keys that establish the color palette, mood, lighting, and atmosphere for key scenes and sequences, following the project's established visual style. 
  • Paint and refine backgrounds that align with the existing art direction, color keys, and overall aesthetic of the project. 
  • Maintain visual consistency across scenes, environments, and sequences. 
  • Collaborate with the Design team and Art Director to interpret visual direction and deliver artwork that meets the project's creative and production requirements. 
  • Incorporate feedback and revisions while meeting production schedules and quality expectations. 

Qualifications 

  • Experience in color key development and background painting for animation. 
  • A strong understanding of color theory, lighting, composition, perspective, and atmosphere. 
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong color keys and painted backgrounds, ideally in a stylized CG animation aesthetic. 
  • Ability to work within an established visual style and maintain consistency across assigned artwork. 
  • Strong attention to detail, communication, and collaboration skills. 
  • Ability to manage priorities, respond to feedback, and meet deadlines in a production environment. 

Nice to Have 

  • Previous experience on stylized CG animated TV productions, featurettes, or other short-form animation projects. 
  • Experience joining a production mid-pipeline and adapting quickly to established art direction.

jobs.description:
FLO recherche un développeur backend orienté DevSecOps pour rejoindre son équipe de développement technologique.

Vous interviendrez du code backend jusqu’à l’infrastructure et au déploiement, avec un objectif simple : rendre nos solutions et nos processus de développement plus sécuritaires, fiables et automatisés.

RESPONSABILITÉS

·        Concevoir et développer des services backend, outils internes et automatisations;

·        Concevoir et maintenir les pipelines CI/CD;

·        Automatiser et faire évoluer notre infrastructure avec Terraform/OpenTofu;

jobs.title: Programming Manager
jobs.description:
At BOS Innovations, we are driven by a clear purpose: to deliver exceptional industrial automation solutions that solve real manufacturing challenges and enable our customers to compete at the highest levels. For over 25 years, we’ve partnered with manufacturers across North America, from automotive to energy to advanced industries -providing intelligent automation systems built on precision, reliability, and innovation.

Guided by our core values of Truth, Excellence, Work Ethics, and Innovation, we are committed to serving our customers and supporting one another with integrity and accountability. At BOS, people come first. We believe in cultivating an environment where talented individuals grow into inspired professionals of character and competence. Our purpose is not only to deliver great technology, but also to develop great people - fostering collaboration, continuous learning, and professional growth.

About the Role

The Programming Manager is responsible for leading the PLC and Robotics Programming teams, ensuring the successful execution of programming activities across custom industrial automation projects. This role oversees departmental resources, technical performance, project delivery, and employee development while driving continuous improvement in programming standards, processes, and operational efficiency.

Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, and other operational departments, the Programming Manager ensures programming deliverables meet customer requirements, project timelines, budgets, and BOS quality standards.

Location: London, ON
Employment Type: Full Time
Department: Programming

RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Leadership & Project Execution

  • Provide technical oversight and guidance for PLC, HMI, and Robotics Programming, including system integration, troubleshooting, testing, and commissioning.
  • Support technical reviews, programming optimization, and resolution of complex challenges to ensure reliable and effective automation solutions.
  • Ensure programming deliverables meet customer specifications, project requirements, safety standards, and BOS quality expectations.
  • Act as the primary departmental escalation point for programming-related technical issues, project risks, and delivery challenges.

Department Operations & Resource Management

  • Manage departmental workload, programming schedules, and resource allocation in coordination with Senior Project Leads, Project Managers, and the scheduling team.
  • Maintain short-term and long-term resource plans, including workforce capacity, skill requirements, and external contractor support.
  • Monitor departmental performance against project timelines, labor budgets, quality expectations, and resource utilization.
  • Coordinate programming activities with Mechanical Design, Applications Engineering, Controls Design, Build, and Service & Support teams to ensure effective project execution.
  • Identify potential resource constraints, scheduling conflicts, and project risks, implementing corrective actions or escalating concerns as required.

HR & Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop programming team members through regular feedback, performance evaluations, and individual development planning.
  • Manage recruitment, hiring, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations in collaboration with Human Resources.
  • Maintain departmental skills matrices, identify technical capability gaps, and support training and succession planning.
  • Promote accountability, teamwork, effective communication, and conflict resolution within the department.
  • Oversee employee attendance, timesheet accuracy, labor allocation, and adherence to company policies and safety expectations.

Process Improvement & Department Development

  • Develop, maintain, and improve programming standards, departmental processes, documentation, and quality-control practices.
  • Champion the BOS Playbook and ensure programming procedures, QCC templates, and departmental deliverables remain current and consistently applied.
  • Identify opportunities to improve programming efficiency, standardization, knowledge sharing, and technical capabilities.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Operations on departmental strategy, workforce planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support Applications Engineering with technical feasibility, programming solutions, and labor estimates during project development and quoting.

This description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned. BOS welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Your interest in this opportunity is appreciated. Applicants must be eligible to work in Canada. Only those applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.requirementsSection:
• Post-secondary degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in industrial automation, including PLC programming, robotics integration, and commissioning of custom automation systems.
  • Minimum 3 years of demonstrated technical leadership or people management experience, including team development, resource planning, and project coordination.
  • Strong technical knowledge of PLC platforms such as Rockwell, Siemens, Omron, or equivalent, and industrial robotics platforms such as FANUC, ABB, KUKA, or Yaskawa.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple project priorities, programming resources, and technical deliverables within established schedules and budgets.
  • Strong understanding of industrial automation integration, programming standards, machine safety, and commissioning practices.
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
